messages:
anya: Quick check-in on pilot model bring-up (pilot-13b-lite/int6). Ran a small quant sweep; saw decent token-cost wins but some quality drift on multi-turn summarization. Posting quick notes.

liam: What metrics are showing drift? single-turn or multi-turn only?

anya: Single-turn metrics (ROUGE/EM) look stable; multi-turn conversational P@1 down ~4-6 points on our conv_long set. Example:

anya: ```
> prompt: "Summarize the thread and suggest follow-ups"
model(fp16): "... concise plan + clarifying Qs"
model(int6): "... partial plan; missed follow-up Q"
```

sofia: Can you paste the eval command and sample outputs?

anya: Eval command I ran:
```bash
python eval.py --model pilot-13b-int6 --dataset conv_long --metrics p@1,recall,coherence --seed 42
```
Sample: `p@1: fp16 0.72 -> int6 0.68` ; coherence delta ~ -0.03.

marta: What's the unit-econ delta? token cost and p95 latency numbers vs fp16?

anya: Rough numbers from the bench: int6 token compute cost ~ -30% vs fp16. p95 latency +5% on long-context cases due to kernel fallback for attention. Overall per-request $ down ~22% for short sessions, only ~8% for long sessions.

liam: Could we do hybrid routing: short sessions and single-turns to int6, multi-turns to fp16? Also consider prefix/KV caching to reduce recall impact.

sofia: Also worth testing confidence-based fallback: run int6 and if response score (logprob/confidence) low, resend to fp16. Threshold tuning required.

anya: Proposal: AB with heuristics: route based on session length and expected multi-turn prob. Start with 70% traffic short-session -> int6, long-session -> fp16; enable confidence fallback for low-scoring outputs. Holdback set for GTN integration and manual review.

marta: I'll build a one-page unit-econ scorecard for GTN: cost delta, quality delta, latency p95, monthly $ impact at 1M requests. Will include recommended rollout %.

liam: :thumbsup: I'll run a 24h synthetic traffic test with mixed session lengths to capture tail behavior (Jupyter job + eval hooks).

 dev-bot: start run: job id 18392, status: queued, ETA ~24h

anya: Thanks — capturing 3 edge-case transcripts in #eval-artifacts: https://redwood.internal/testcases/18392 :eyes: 

sofia: When you run the AB, add our conversational coherence hook and deflection metrics. Those pick up the failure mode faster.

marta: Plan: once 24h run completes, synthesize rec + dashboard snapshot and target a GTN sync next Tue.

anya: tagging @product-ops @gtn for visibility. Any other quick asks?

liam: Please log the eval config (seed, token limits, temp) in the run metadata. I'll link results to the rollout flags.

anya: done — config attached to job 18392. Thanks all :rocket:
